summary.title: SEI Digital Library | CMU Software Engineering Institute
summary.one_liner: The SEI Digital Library is a searchable archive of more than 6,000 Carnegie Mellon SEI documents, webcasts, and podcasts on software engineering practice, and this listing page shows its latest additions.
takeaways: The SEI Digital Library holds over 6,000 documents from four decades of software engineering research.
Materials include technical reports, presentations, webcasts, podcasts, and educational material.
Documents can be searched by keyword and filtered by topic, publication type, year, and author.
Recent listings cover cybersecurity research priorities, threat modeling, software acquisition, ML component quality, and MBSE with AI.
summary.summary: This is the landing page of the SEI Digital Library from Carnegie Mellon University's Software Engineering Institute. According to the page description, the library offers more than 6,000 documents from four decades of software engineering research, searchable by keyword and organized by topic, publication type, year, and author. The page text shows a list of latest publications, each with a short description and type label (webcast, video, book, SEI report, podcast, conference paper, or educational material). The listing itself does not contain detailed technical content beyond these brief abstracts.
